title: Legally Binding but Unfair? Towards Assessing Fairness of Privacy Policies
findings: The paper did not present any findings related to religion. Although it used descriptor terms from the HolisticBias dataset (which includes a religion axis), the authors did not include religion in their analysis of representational fairness.

measurement_description: The paper did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. Its focus was on informational fairness, representational fairness (across axes like gender, age, nationality, disability), and ethics/morality in privacy policies.
